La descarbonización de las cadenas de su:
Decarbonizing supply chains is no longer an option, but a global necessity.
                            One of the fundamental pillars to achieve this is the integration of renewable energies in each
                            link in the process, from production to distribution. Unlike fuel
                            fossils, clean energies such as solar, wind and green hydrogen, not only reduce emissions,
                            but they also improve operational efficiency and reduce dependence on volatile markets, therefore they must be audited
                            energy consumption in each phase of the chain.
                            Large corporations are already migrating to solar or wind farms to supply their production centers,
                            while freight transportation begins to be electrified with fleets powered by batteries or hydrogen.
                            However, the real challenge is scalability: renewable technologies must be accessible
                            for companies of all sizes and adapt to the geographical and logistical particularities of each sector.
